units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2) the manufacturer designated as sole supplier, whose information is entered in the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 3) the name of goods whose production is established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under the special investment contract and for which supply contracts may be concluded under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 4) the federal executive authority establishing, for procurement under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law:
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: а) the procedure for determining the maximum unit price of goods whose production is established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under the special investment contract, taking account of the general requirements under paragraph 3(4) of this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 4 Part 2 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: б) the procedure for determining the price of a contract with the manufacturer.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 4 Part 2 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation shall:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1) establish the procedure for maintaining the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2) designate the federal executive authority authorised to maintain the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 3) establish the procedure for preparing the Government act specified in paragraph 1 of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 4) establish general requirements for the maximum-unit-price determination procedure referred to in paragraph 2(4)(а) of this Article for goods whose production is established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 5) establish the form and content requirements of the report on compliance with paragraph 1(5)(а) of this Article and the time limits for posting it in the unified information system.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 4. In the manner and within the periods specified in the special investment contract, the federal executive authority that concluded it on behalf of the Russian Federation shall decide:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1) the starting date of the period during which contracting authorities may conclude contracts with the manufacturer under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law for goods whose production has been established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under the special investment contract, subject to compliance with paragraph 1(4) of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2) extension by one year after expiry of the special investment contract of the period for procurement under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law, if during at least one calendar year the manufacturer exported goods whose production was established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under that investment contract in an amount of at least ten percent of that year's output of those goods.
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 5. Under the procedure in paragraph 3(1) of this Article, the federal executive authority that concluded the special investment contract on behalf of the Russian Federation shall ensure entry in the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed, including the following information and documents:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1) the name, trade name if any, location, postal address and contact telephone number of the sole supplier that is the manufacturer, and the name of the federal executive authority that concluded the special investment contract on behalf of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2) the name of goods whose production is established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under the special investment contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 3) the term of the special investment contract;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 4) the planned period during which the contracting authority may conclude a supply contract under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law, determined under the special investment contract taking account of the planned time for satisfying paragraph 1(4) of this Article;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 5) the investment specified in the special investment contract for establishing, modernising and/or mastering production in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 6) the name of the federal executive authority designated under paragraph 2(4) of this Article;
units.label: Point 6 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 7) the actual period during which the contracting authority may conclude a supply contract under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law. It shall start on the date determined under paragraph 4(1) of this Article and end on expiry of the special investment contract or on the date determined under paragraph 4(2) of this Article;
units.label: Point 7 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 8) the particulars of the Government act specified in paragraph 1 of this Article;
units.label: Point 8 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 9) information on amendments to the special investment contract terms, insofar as information on those terms is entered in the register;
units.label: Point 9 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 10) information on termination of the special investment contract.
units.label: Point 10 Part 5 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 6. A contract with a sole supplier under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law for goods whose production has been established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract shall be concluded subject to the following:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1) the contract shall be concluded during the period specified in paragraph 5(7) of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2) the term of the contract with the sole supplier that is the manufacturer may not extend beyond the special investment contract's term or the period set under paragraph 4(2) of this Article, taking account of Russian Federation budget legislation and international obligations;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 3) the unit price of goods supplied under the contract may not exceed the maximum price determined in the procedure established under paragraph 2(4)(а) of this Article. The contract price shall be determined in the procedure established under paragraph 2(4)(б) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 4) the contract shall be for goods produced under the special investment contract and specified in the Government act under paragraph 1 of this Article;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 5) the goods supplied, whose production was established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation in performing the special investment contract, shall qualify as goods of Russian origin under Russian Federation legislation.
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 7. Under this Article, the Government of the Russian Federation may designate several manufacturers of similar or identical goods with whom contracting authorities may conclude contracts under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.label: Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1. A contracting authority may conduct procurement under this Federal Law resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations, subject to the following:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) procurement shall be based on an act of the highest executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) procurement shall be through an electronic tender under this Federal Law and the special rules in this Article;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3) only legal entities may participate;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4) goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered shall meet the criteria confirming Russian industrial production established under Federal Law No. 488-FZ of 31 December 2014 On Industrial Policy in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2. The act of the constituent entity's highest executive authority under paragraph 1(1) of this Article shall specify:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) the contracting authority, or authorities in a joint electronic tender under paragraph 9 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) the name of goods whose production is to be established, modernised or mastered and/or services to be provided using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property to be created or reconstructed, and, if necessary, requirements for their characteristics;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3) the term of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations, which may not exceed ten years;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4) the maximum period for establishing, modernising or mastering goods production and/or creating or reconstructing immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property for providing services, which may not exceed the term of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 5) the minimum investment to be made by the participant with whom the contract with reciprocal investment obligations is concluded in establishing, modernising or mastering goods production and/or creating or reconstructing immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property for providing services, which shall be at least one hundred million roubles. For a joint electronic tender under paragraph 9 of this Article, a common minimum investment of at least one hundred million roubles shall be set for all contracts, regardless of their number;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 6) a requirement to establish, modernise or master goods production and/or create or reconstruct immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property for providing services within the constituent entity and/or another constituent entity, provided they have concluded an agreement making territory available for that purpose, except for procurement for two or more constituent entities under paragraph 4 of this Article;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 7) the minimum output capacity to be ensured by the production established, modernised or mastered and/or the minimum service capacity to be ensured using the immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property created or reconstructed;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 8) the maximum quantity of goods and/or volume of services that the participant with whom the contract with reciprocal investment obligations is concluded may supply and/or provide in one calendar year under contracts concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law. These maxima shall not exceed thirty percent of the goods produced and/or services provided by that supplier (service provider) during the calendar year. Maxima need not be set if, in procurement for one constituent entity, the minimum investment determined under point 5 of this paragraph exceeds one billion roubles;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 9) requirements for the procedures under point 10, subpoints а and б, of this paragraph for determining the maximum unit price of goods whose production has been established, modernised or mastered and/or services provided using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that has been created or reconstructed, and for determining the price of a contract with a supplier (service provider) party to a contract with reciprocal investment obligations, for procurement under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 10) the constituent entity's executive authority establishing, for procurement under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law:
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: а) the procedure for determining the maximum unit price of goods whose production has been established, modernised or mastered and/or services provided using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that has been created or reconstructed, taking account of the requirements under point 9 of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 10 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: б) the procedure for determining the price of a contract with a supplier (service provider) party to a contract with reciprocal investment obligations, taking account of the requirements under point 9 of this paragraph.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 10 Part 2 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3. A contract with reciprocal investment obligations shall contain terms:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) determined under paragraph 2, points 1–8, of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) requiring goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered to meet the criteria confirming Russian industrial production under Federal Law No. 488-FZ of 31 December 2014 On Industrial Policy in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3) requiring goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered and/or services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed to be supplied or provided under a contract under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law at a price not exceeding the maximum determined under paragraph 2(10)(а) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4) imposing a fine of fifty percent of the value of any excess over the goods quantity and/or service volume determined under paragraph 2(8) of this Article, where a maximum annual quantity and/or volume has been set for the supplier (service provider) under contracts concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 5) requiring the supplier (service provider) to prepare, sign with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on its behalf, and post in the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed, a report on goods produced and/or services provided during one calendar year, and goods supplied and/or services provided during that year under its contracts concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4. Procurement under this Article may serve two or more constituent entities of the Russian Federation through a joint electronic tender under Article 25 of this Federal Law, subject to the special rules in this Article and based on:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) an agreement between constituent entities of the Russian Federation determining:
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: а) the conditions under paragraph 2, points 1–10, of this Article, subject to the following:
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: the minimum investment under paragraph 2(5) of this Article shall be at least four hundred million roubles;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.4 · “the minimum investment under paragraph 2(5) of this Article…”

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: for each constituent entity party to the agreement, the maximum goods quantity and/or service volume that the supplier (service provider) may supply or provide in one calendar year under contracts concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law shall be set. For all constituent entities party to the agreement together, the quantity and/or volume shall not exceed thirty percent of the goods produced and/or services provided by that supplier (service provider) during the calendar year. If minimum investment under paragraph 2(5) of this Article exceeds one billion roubles, one constituent entity may be designated whose procurement under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law, including procurement by municipalities within it, shall not count towards those quantities and/or volumes supplied or provided under contracts concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.4 · “for each constituent entity party to the agreement, the maximum…”

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: б) the parties' rights, obligations and liability, and dispute resolution procedure;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: в) the organiser of the joint electronic tender;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 111.4
